title: 6 Day Botswana Honeymoon Safari: Okavango Delta and Chobe
rank_math_title: Botswana Honeymoon Safari: 6 Days, Okavango and Chobe
rank_math_desc: Botswana honeymoon safari for 6 days: three nights at Pom Pom Camp in the Okavango Delta and two nights at Chobe Chilwero, linked by light aircraft.
post_content: This Botswana honeymoon safari keeps the group small and the scenery wild.
overview:
This Botswana honeymoon safari keeps the group small and the scenery wild. Fly from Maun to Pom Pom Camp in a private concession of the Okavango Delta for three nights of game drives, mokoro trips and bush dinners, then fly to Kasane for two nights at Chobe Chilwero above the Chobe River, famous for its elephant herds. It suits couples who want a quiet, exclusive Delta experience, and it combines easily with Victoria Falls.

Price: from USD 4,030 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Three nights in a private Okavango Delta concession at Pom Pom Camp
Two nights at Chobe Chilwero above the Chobe River

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Maun to the Okavango Delta
itinerary.content: Fly by light aircraft from Maun to Pom Pom Camp. Afternoon activity. Dinner and overnight at Pom Pom Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Okavango Delta
itinerary.content: Morning and afternoon game drives or mokoro trips, depending on water levels. Dinner and overnight at Pom Pom Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Okavango Delta
itinerary.content: A full day exploring the concession by vehicle, boat or on foot. Dinner and overnight at Pom Pom Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Fly to Chobe
itinerary.content: Fly to Kasane and transfer to the lodge. Sunset cruise on the Chobe River. Dinner and overnight at Chobe Chilwero.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Chobe National Park
itinerary.content: Morning game drive and afternoon boat safari. Dinner and overnight at Chobe Chilwero.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.content: Transfer to Kasane airport or continue by road to Victoria Falls.
